articles.headline: Donovan Mitchell and Coco Jones wed in Greenwich ceremony
articles.description: Mitchell and Jones shared their first dance to Musiq Soulchild's 2000 hit song "Love," as seen in a video posted by agent Troy Payne on Instagram.

articles.headline: Sources: Mavs extend Naji Marshall on 3-year, $52.2M deal
articles.description: Mavericks forward Naji Marshall signed a three-year, $52.2 million extension that will take him through the 2029-30 season, sources told ESPN.

articles.headline: Holmgren: Thunder departures part of 'business of this game'
articles.description: Oklahoma City's Chet Holmgren told reporters Saturday afternoon that the departures of three contributors to the Thunder's 2025 championship team felt "like losing a family member," but at the same time, "that's how the business of this game goes."

articles.headline: Sources: Warriors bring back Gary Payton II on vet minimum
articles.description: The Warriors are bringing back forward Gary Payton II on a one-year, $3.9 million veteran minimum deal, sources said.
